name: Aurora Pro ANC Wireless Headphones
shortDescription: Reference-grade active noise cancellation, 40-hour battery, and adaptive spatial audio in a featherweight aluminum frame.
description: The Aurora Pro ANC delivers studio-reference sound with adaptive, scene-aware noise cancellation that reads your environment 50,000 times a second. A recycled-aluminum frame keeps weight to 248g, while memory-foam earcups stay comfortable through the full 40-hour battery. Multipoint Bluetooth 5.4 pairs two devices at once, and a 5-minute quick charge returns 6 hours of playback.
highlights: Adaptive spatial audio with head tracking

images.alt: Aurora Pro ANC in midnight black, three-quarter view
